jobs.how: AHU Loc/Net must read Network first; it can only be changed at the keypad. Command occupancy with Occupancy Mode, or set it to Auto and feed the scheduler inputs. Emergency Override = Off stops the unit and only Normal restarts it.

points.use: Read: must show 1=Network; change at the keypad only
Write current scheduled state when Occupancy Mode is Auto
Write minutes until the next state (scheduler input)
Write 2=Off to shut down; write 1=Normal to restart
Read: unit status; 4=Off Net after a network shutdown

jobs.how: Application Mode only takes effect when Control Mode is Auto, which is set at the keypad. Write the occupied and unoccupied space setpoints, or the network discharge air setpoints on discharge-control units, and read back the effective discharge setpoint.

points.use: Write: network discharge air cooling setpoint
Write: network discharge air heating setpoint
Read: effective discharge air temperature setpoint

jobs.how: Trend Unit State with the main air temperatures and the cooling, heating and economizer capacity values. Which sensors are present depends on unit type and options.

Read fan capacities and duct and building static pressure, and write the static pressure setpoints. Network fan capacity inputs only apply when the matching remote control flag and unit option are configured.

points.use: Write: duct static pressure setpoint, inWC
Write: building static pressure setpoint, inWC

jobs.how: Each status point says whether that function is enabled or why it is off (ambient, alarm, network or manual). Use them to explain why a unit is not cooling or heating.
Read outdoor airflow and space CO2 and RH, and write the outdoor airflow, humidity and dew point setpoints where the unit has those options. Network Demand Shed can be switched from the BMS.

points.use: Write: outdoor air damper minimum position, %
Write 2=Active to enable network demand shed

jobs.job: Sensor values the BMS can supply
jobs.how: Write network space and outdoor temperatures, humidity and IAQ when the unit is configured for them. A bad network space value falls back to the local sensor; out-of-range outdoor writes revert to Null.

points.use: Read: local space temperature, to compare
Read: local outdoor air temperature, to compare
Write fallback time, s; unsupported on application 2506017300+

jobs.how: Read the fault, problem and warning number values (0 = none) and the alarm source inputs. The alarm BVs are legacy and should not be written. Use Clear Alarms only to clear an active alarm, not continuously.

points.use: Read: highest-priority active fault number, 0 = none
Read: airflow switch input, airflow fault source
Read: duct high limit source input

checklist: Set the device instance at the keypad (the initial value comes from the production code on IP or the MAC on MS/TP) and use Apply Changes in the BACnet setup menu.
Check the comm settings: IP defaults to DHCP on UDP 47808; MS/TP defaults to MAC 18, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, with Term Resistor set at the keypad.
Set AHU Loc/Net to Network at the keypad and confirm MV 38 (AHU Loc/Net) reads 1=Network.
Read MV 111 (UnitType), MV 112 (CtrlType), MV 113 (ClgType) and MV 119 (HtgType) to see which objects apply to this unit.
Verify reads of MV 15 (UnitState), MV 1 (unit status), AI 1 (DischAirTemp) and AI 3 (SpaceTemp) against the keypad.
Write AV 9 (OccCoolSP) and MV 7 (OccManCmd) = 1 Occ, then confirm MV 6 (EffectOccup) shows Occ.
Write MV 10 (EmergOverride) = 2 Off, confirm MV 1 shows Off Net, then write 1 Normal and confirm the unit restarts.
Map AV 26 (ActiveFault), AV 25 (ActiveProblem) and AV 24 (ActiveWarning) as alarms, skipping the legacy alarm BVs.
